node.title: Re^3: Perl CGI.PM: Use of uninitialized value $vals
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: While you could certainly investigate and debug [mod://CGI].pm, you really shouldn't use -w on the shebang line (#!/usr/bin/perl -w) and [doc://warnings|use warnings;] instead. See [doc://warnings#What's-wrong-with-*-w*-and-$^W|What's wrong with -w and $^W].
